body.name: finite equality-active candidate family
body.construction: Let \(z_0=-G^{-1}h\). For each independent \(I\subseteq\{1,2,3,4\}\) with \(1\le|I|\le2\), set \(z_I=z_0+G^{-1}C_I^{\top}(C_IG^{-1}C_I^{\top})^{-1}(a_I-C_Iz_0)\); retain \(z_0\) and the \(z_I\) that satisfy all four sector inequalities.
